articles.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum race quantum clock as U.S. backs $300 million hardware push
articles.snippet: The threat is not here yet, but fault-tolerant machines and crypto’s migration plans are starting to converge on the same 2029 window.

articles.title: Algorand names former Chainlink executive William Herkelrath as CEO
articles.snippet: The former Chainlink and Curv executive will lead the blockchain organization’s push into institutional finance and quantum-resistant security.

articles.title: While Bitcoin Devs Debate Next Moves, IonQ Unveils Superion 256 Quantum Computer
articles.snippet: The company has built its first chips and begun testing prototypes as it seeks to manufacture quantum computers in larger quantities.

articles.title: Ethereum Proposal Would Let Users Pay Gas Without Holding ETH
articles.snippet: EIP-8141 has been a draft since January, and its authors pitch it first as a defense against quantum computers.
